{{Top|leg}}
A '''ruined outpost''' was a location on the continent of [[Laz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. It contained [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ruins. The area was owned by a wealthy but eccentric member of the [[Lazerian (people)|Lazerian]] Nobility.<ref name="Kira">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>
